_ratified: human-ratified: ONE implementation role for this repository, in the primary checkout. This repository runs a single Pi session (AgentDocumentor), so declaring web/ and server/ as separate roles would name agents that do not exist and split one feature across a boundary neither side owns. The role is unrestrictedWrite because this repository is a CONSUMER of an external interface -- llm-wiki-compiler's HTTP ingest job contract, documented at /home/urgosxd/Desktop/ofk/llm-wiki-compiler/docs/guides/http-ingest-jobs.mdx -- and its coordinator must be able to record interface decisions and repair infrastructure. llm-wiki-compiler is a SEPARATE repository and is deliberately not declared here: this contract governs writes inside AgentDocumentor only. Splitting into web/ and server/ roles later is a data edit, and it must create the worktrees in the same change or the full validation rejects it.
